title: Binary Tree Inorder Traversal
statement_md:
Given the root of a binary tree, return the inorder traversal of its nodes' values.

Binary tree input is represented as level-order serialization with `null` indicating empty branches.

hints.text: Inorder traversal visits: Left subtree -> Current Node -> Right subtree.
Can be done recursively, or iteratively using an explicit stack.
Push all left nodes onto a stack until reaching null. Pop, visit, then pivot to `node.right`.

editorial_md:
### Optimal Approach: Iterative Stack

Traverse leftwards continuously pushing nodes into stack. Once null is reached, pop the top node, append to result, and move right.

- Time Complexity: $O(n)$
- Space Complexity: $O(h)$ where $h$ is tree height
